objective: Implement the existing SDD-OBS-001 execution-origin contract for concrete verification-unit admission and launch authority, specifically M53-AC37, M53-AC45 through M53-AC48, M53-AC50 through M53-AC51, M53-AC56, and M53-AC66 through M53-AC75, as mapped by AC-OBS-040 through AC-OBS-043, AC-OBS-050 through AC-OBS-052, AC-HANDOFF-01/03/05/07/09/10/12/13/14/16, and AC-LAUNCH-01 through AC-LAUNCH-15. Bind the exact lifecycle-accepted plan, attempt/generation, candidate/surface, complete obligation/member set, profile/policy and immutable task/independent origin. Commit admission plus launch_reservation in the same .agent-state CAS, preserve the reservation as a replan barrier, then require distinct single-use launch_consumption and its winner-only ephemeral capability before physical launch. Bind terminal receipt/completion to exact consumption and coverage. Keep real execution environment-blocked when no backend is qualified; controlled backends exercise lifecycle authority only. Do not change the accepted spec or relax existing fail-closed guards. Coverage acceptance for AC-OBS-060, AC-OBS-058 and AC-OBS-048 is in scope: in the same .agent-state coverage transaction, bind a verified manual observation to the exact accepted plan, obligation, candidate and surface, and invoke verify_manual_observation_for_coverage inside that transaction. Extend that verifier for attestations carrying plan and obligations. Preserve all existing fail-closed admission, consumption, receipt and backend-qualification requirements. Do not implement until Harness reviews this replanned packet. Add the accepted-profile source for required_manual_reviewer_principal and the per-gate origin policy required by AC-OBS-043: extend the T-001 profile/model/planner/schema/tests, and update the Showcase profile and its tests as needed. Bind the exact required principal and per-gate origin into profile_hash, obligation, family, and final-plan identity; reject cross-principal signatures and any untrusted request attempting to upgrade a gate origin. T-001 and T-006 remain historical checkpoints; T-900 evaluates the combined implementation.
test_seam: Use a real disposable .agent-state lifecycle fixture and independent controlled backend. Tests must first fail for task-only-to-independent upgrade, missing/extra/stale obligation membership, replan-vs-admission CAS races, duplicate reservation consumption, crash/lost reply after every durable transition, stale executor/capability, mismatched terminal receipt, and qualified-backend absence. Prove no physical launch or independent PASS on absent qualification; do not replace lifecycle storage with a mock for CAS claims or remove fail-closed guards. Add coverage-acceptance tests for AC-OBS-060/058/048: a valid attestation carrying the exact plan and obligation must be re-verified by verify_manual_observation_for_coverage within the same .agent-state transaction that binds the observation to the exact plan, obligation, candidate and surface; mismatched plan, obligation, candidate or surface must fail closed without recording accepted coverage; prove a failed verification cannot leave a partial coverage claim. Keep the admission unit tests in tooling/agent-harness/tests/test_verification_admission.py and implementation in tooling/agent-harness/verification/admission.py. Add profile/origin tests first: a manual-origin gate without exactly one registered, enabled manual-review principal invalidates the profile before plan publication; the principal and per-gate origin are included in profile_hash, obligation, family and final-plan identity, and changing either changes plan_id; a valid signature from another principal is refused for the obligation; an untrusted request cannot upgrade gate origin. Cover profile schema/loader, planner, Showcase profile and plan serialization as applicable. Add the accepted T-009 coverage cases: superseded/historical plan plus dirty or non-exact candidate/surface returns MANUAL_EVIDENCE_CANDIDATE_BINDING_REQUIRED (exit 5) without mutation; stored attestation/report bytes changed between registration and coverage are refused inside the CAS; exact replay is idempotent and conflicting replay is refused; coverage racing replan or completion has one winner under the same lifecycle lock; manual evidence never authorizes retry and a grant never counts as criterion evidence. Exercise safe prelaunch-abort terminalization: after admission/reservation but before physical launch, abort only the exact reservation/consumption, produce a terminal receipt bound to the same plan/attempt/generation/candidate/surface, prevent launch, and prove retries/replays cannot strand or double-consume lifecycle state. Preserve all existing fail-closed requirements. Add true integration coverage with a real temporary Git repository, committed profile and issuer registry, real candidate sealing, signature verification, plan publication/loading, registration and coverage CAS; no mocks for those trust boundaries. Exercise process death and injected exceptions after reserve-only and consume-before-launch, proving owner PID+start-time fencing and safe_prelaunch_abort with no physical launch or stuck admission. Assert the required MANUAL_EVIDENCE_* reason codes and exit-5 behavior for plan-bound scope errors and coverage CLI. Add mutation-sensitive tests for immutable binding/seal/commit evidence, both reseals, the coverage lock outcome, replan race, every safe-abort shape/receipt guard, and telemetry/profile role-origin checks. Keep all changes inside the packet allowed_paths.
title: Implement lifecycle-bound execution-origin admission (AH5-04a-2)
